args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST

Essential Items:
- Passport/ID
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap
- Beach towel
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Flip flops or sandals
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light jacket or cardigan (for air-conditioned spaces)

Clothing:
- T-shirts and light tops
- Shorts
- Casual dresses
- Light pants
- Underwear and socks
- Pajamas

Beach and Water Activities:
- Beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (if available)
- Water shoes
- Beach umbrella or canopy
- Inflatable floaties
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach games (frisbee, volleyball)

Health and Safety:
- First aid kit
- Prescription medications
- Motion sickness medication
- Insect repellent
- Hand sanitizer
- Wet wipes
- Deodorant

Electronics:
- Camera and charger
- Phone and charger
- Portable power bank
- Waterproof phone pouch
- Headphones

Documents and Money:
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservations
- Car rental confirmation
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable water bottle
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask
- Earplugs
- Laundry detergent sheets
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Ziploc bags (various sizes)
- Laundry bag

Weather Considerations:
- Hawaii is warm and humid year-round
- Pack layers for air-conditioned venues
- Consider rain gear for unexpected showers
- Sun protection is crucial

Enjoy your Hawaiian vacation!
